text:
Ana Patel: Quick heads up — ACME Models signed off on a co-pack with PartnerEdge (HW) for the 7B quantized variant. Thinking of a bundled SKU for marketplace + hardware. Need legal + product sync. :wave:

Mike Chen: Nice. Do we have constraints from ACME on redistribution of quantized weights? @LegalBot

LegalBot: Short answer: we need explicit redistribution rights for the quantized variant and a trademark usage clause. Also export control check (ECCN). I'll paste a short checklist:
```text
- Redistribution rights for quantized weights: required
- Attribution and trademark usage: approved template
- Export compliance: supplier declaration
- Warranty / support split: defined per SKU
```

Sasha Li: From infra side: quantized model needs a specific runtime build (int8 kernel); we'll need model artifact naming convention and a checksum for the bundle. Any version pinning requests from ACME?

Ana Patel: ACME wants version pinned to v1.2-q (no auto-upgrades). They agreed to a canary rollout on Redwood Dedicated for first 2 weeks.

Jess Ortega: For marketplace listing, product copy + logos needed. Suggest we do a single landing page that links hardware bundle + model page. Who owns creative? @Leo

Leo Santos: Growth can own creative. Ask ACME for hi-res logo and short blurb. I'll draft co-marketing timeline. Proposed: 2-week embargo, simultaneous press release + marketplace listing day 0, partner webcast day 3.

Mike Chen: Pricing: ACME proposes rev-share 70/30 (ACME/Partner). Need finance to sign off. Also decide SKU map:
```text
- SKU_BUNDLE_ACME7B_PE: ACME 7B quant + PartnerEdge A100-1
- SKU_MODEL_ACME7B_Q: ACME 7B quant (hosted only)
- SKU_HW_ONLY_PE: PartnerEdge hardware SKU
```

LegalBot: Rev-share acceptable subject to ARR threshold and payment cadence. Add indemnity language for model outputs (no changes to model weights allowed by partner). Also confirm licensing (perpetual runtime redistrib vs. time-limited). Prefer time-limited license for quantized artifacts.

Ana Patel: Noted. Action items:
- Legal: finalize redistribution and license window (LegalBot) — due EOD Thu
- Product: draft SKU map + listing copy (Jess) — mini'd by Mon
- Infra: artifact naming + runtime requirements + checksum (Sasha) — end of week
- Growth: co-marketing assets + timeline (Leo) — first draft Fri
- Eng Sales: confirm rev-share with ACME (Mike) — sync with finance

Sasha Li: Also please include test prompt set for quality regression checks. We need that before canary.

Ana Patel: Good catch. @ACME point of contact will send prompt set + model card. I'll loop them in on email after this thread. :email:

DeployBot: Canary deployment scheduled: canary-ACME7B-q -> Redwood Dedicated cluster pe-42 on 2026-04-02 10:00 UTC (tentative)

Jess Ortega: Thanks everyone — I'll slot a 30m sync Wed to finalize marketplace copy. Ping me if blockers pop up. :thumbsup:

Mike Chen: I'll bring finance numbers to Wed sync.

Ana Patel: Closing notes: keep communications embargoed. No external mention until legal signs off and assets are ready. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
